steps.name: an idle socket on a pool URL, with no pings, closes at 125 s with 1006
wrangler dev keeps idle sockets open for 360 s with no pings
with pings, idle sockets stay open until a rollout closes them at 695 s
a rollout closes sockets with 1012, and each client reconnects on the first try
a socket can also close with 1011 when its object's generation ends
after a rollout the object is a new instance, and an accepted socket's storage is kept
a cut client gives the object webSocketClose 1006 within about 1 s, and the object sleeps
a client that stops answering pings is closed with 1006 at about 90 s, and the object sleeps
